map.宠物年龄换算（冷门） 使用指南: Pet Age Conversion (Less Common Breeds) User Guide
map.输入猫或狗的实足年龄，按物种换算为对应的人类年龄阶段，帮助主人理解宠物的生命阶段: Enter a cat's or dog's exact age and convert it by species into the matching human age stage, helping owners understand the pet's life stage and care priorities. Used for pet health education and veterinary communication.
map.按猫或狗的实际年龄换算为“人类年龄”，直观了解宠物所处生命阶段。: Convert a cat's or dog's real age into "human age" to intuitively understand the pet's life stage.
map.按犬型（小型/中型/大型/巨型）分别换算，因为大型犬衰老更快。: Convert separately by dog size (small/medium/large/giant), because large dogs age faster.
map.结合平均寿命估算剩余陪伴时间，规划体检与护理重点。: Estimate the remaining time together from average lifespan, to plan checkups and care priorities.
map.：采用分年龄对照表线性插值：取整数岁 idx = floor(年龄)，人类年龄: Uses linear interpolation on the age-banded table: take idx = floor(age), human age = round(table[idx] + (table[idx+1] - table[idx]) x fraction); beyond the table each additional year adds 4 human years. Cats and small dogs start at 15 in year one and 24 in year two; after that cats and small dogs gain about 4 per year, medium dogs 4-5, large dogs 5-6 and giant dogs about 6. Life stages (human age): 0-1 infant, 1-3 child, 3-6 adult, 6-9 middle age, 9-13 early senior, 13+ senior. Average lifespan: cats 15 years; small dogs 15, medium 13, large 11, giant 9 years.
map.：猫 3 岁 → 对照表第 3 项 = 32 人类岁（成年期）；猫 2.5 岁: A 3-year-old cat -> item 3 of the table = 32 human years (adult); a 2.5-year-old cat = 28 + (32-28)x0.5 = 30 human years. A 5-year-old medium dog -> item 5 of the medium table = 42 human years; a 5-year-old large dog -> 45 human years, so a large dog converts to an older age at the same real age.
map.为什么不能用“1 年 = 7 岁”？: Why can't you use "1 year = 7 years"?
map.宠物早年发育极快（1 岁即相当于人类 15 岁），之后趋缓，且与体型强相关；“乘: Pets develop extremely fast in their early years (1 year already equals about 15 human years), then slow down, and it correlates strongly with body size; "times 7" badly underestimates the young and overestimates a large dog's later years, so an age-banded table is the right approach.
map.大型犬折算年龄为什么更高？: Why is the converted age higher for large dogs?
map.大型犬寿命短、衰老快，同样 5 岁的大型犬身体状态已相当于人类中年，而小型犬仍在: Large dogs have shorter lifespans and age faster; at the same 5 years a large dog's condition already matches middle-aged humans while a small dog is still in its prime, so splitting the list by size is closer to reality.
